description: The spec documents no coded error bodies for PATCH /envs/{id}. Live probes against https://api.inngest.com/v2 on 2026-10-06: PATCH /envs/{id} with an unknown id answers 404 {errors:[{code:"env_not_found",message:"Environment not found"}]}.

traits.smithy.api#documentation: No environment has the given id (Inngest `env_not_found`, HTTP 404).
